pages.heading: How Qimam People Helps
pages.body: For Nile Logistics, this is a short guide to an outsourced HR operations desk for payroll and onboarding support.

pages.heading: Why this matters now
pages.body:
Nile Logistics currently lists four open payroll and HR administrator vacancies on its careers page. That can make day-to-day people operations harder to keep consistent as the team grows.

Qimam People is an outsourced HR operations desk based in Cairo. It is built for companies with 30–300 staff that do not have an in-house payroll team.

items.title: Run payroll
items.text: Qimam People handles payroll operations as an outsourced service.

items.title: Support onboarding
items.text: It also runs employee onboarding so new starters can be brought in through one team.

items.title: One operating desk
items.text: Payroll and onboarding sit together, instead of being split across several internal owners.

pages.heading: What we can point to
pages.body:
Nile Logistics lists four open payroll and HR administrator vacancies. That is a clear sign that these responsibilities are active enough to need dedicated attention.

The company also says it opened 3 new warehouses in Alexandria this year. Growth like that often comes with more coordination across people operations, payroll, and onboarding.
